skill_name: Create an essay about the importance of nature conservation.
workflow: Nature is essential to our lives in countless ways, yet it has been forgotten, abused and neglected. Nature conservation is important not only because it helps foster biodiversity, but it also helps us to maintain a healthy and balanced lifestyle. Conservation can protect ecosystems from becoming weakened and vulnerable to climate change, prevent extinction of threatened species, and ensure clean air, water, and food for all.
